messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: models not compiling with rcpp 0.11.0
parts:
I needed to reinstall rstan after upgrading rcpp, which worked but none of the models compile (Error : index out of bounds failed to create the sampler; sampling not done). After downgrading rcpp and re-reinstalling rstan, they work again. This hasn't affected most users yet because the rcpp binaries have not been built yet for 0.11.0 but we should get this fixed before the next stan release.

Ben
